title: .fwos/baseline.json
description: Findings that existed before fwos arrived (adopt mode). Checks fail only on new or worse findings. It can only shrink.

checks.description: The checks the baseline covers and the date each was first recorded. A covered check can only shrink; a check that wasn't on when it was recorded can be taken in once. A file without it covers every check.

findings.description: Per check, each finding's fingerprint and how many findings had it. A file from before counts were kept holds a list of fingerprints (digits read as N); fwos still reads it, and `fwos baseline` rewrites it with counts.
